environment.description: Same Ktor microservice deployed on EKS with Aurora PostgreSQL. The database connection uses role 'audit_reader' which was provisioned via Terraform module 'rds-restricted-role' with pg_hba.conf entry restricting to md5 auth from the service CIDR. The role has been granted through a chain: audit_reader inherits from base_readonly which has SELECT on schema public. No additional grants exist. The Logback configuration uses ConsoleAppender only (no DBAppender). However, the application code still calls writeAuditEntry() which attempts INSERT operations. CloudWatch log group has a subscription filter with metric alarm but no log sanitization is applied at the infrastructure level. The pod runs with default service account and no network policies restrict egress to the RDS endpoint.

config.db_role_inheritance: audit_reader -> base_readonly (SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public)
config.pg_grants: GRANT SELECT ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO base_readonly; GRANT base_readonly TO audit_reader;
config.revocations: REVOKE INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public FROM public; no additional DML grants to audit_reader or base_readonly
config.network: No WAF, direct ALB to pod routing, no NetworkPolicy on egress
